shortDescription: Detect false-positive tests with the J1-J6 judgment framework
longDescription: falsegreen-skill applies six structural judgments (J1-J6) to each test to determine whether it can actually fail when the code breaks. Covers Python (complete C1-C37 falsegreen catalog), TypeScript, and JavaScript. Provides HIGH/LOW confidence findings with evidence and fix hints. Gemini's 1M-token context window enables whole-suite analysis in a single pass, including cross-file case 15 (order-dependent test) detection.
invocation: analyze this test file for false-positive smells
